defaultDescription.zh-CN: 入住伊施格尔核心五星酒店Trofana Royal 4晚（含丰盛半食宿早晚餐），含3日Silvretta Arena 239公里跨国通票，一条雪道从奥地利滑进瑞士萨姆瑙恩免税村。
defaultDescription.en: Spend 4 half-board nights at 5-star Hotel Trofana Royal steps from the Silvretta gondola, bundling a 3-day 239 km cross-border pass into duty-free Samnaun, Switzerland.
